title: RenderResponse
description: Render worker -> Website Publisher: the static files to upload under published-websites/<slug>/ (index.html last). Response limit 6 MB (Lambda); larger output fails with 500 PUBLISH_ASSET_ERROR. Errors use ErrorResponse: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR (invalid draft), 404 NOT_FOUND (unknown template or version), 500 PUBLISH_ASSET_ERROR.

rendererVersion.description: Renderer package version. Also sent as the X-Renderer-Version header in HTTP mode.

path.description: Path relative to the site root, for example index.html or assets/style.css. No leading slash, no '..'.
